Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II and short-lived auditor portal access

Hi Jonas,

Hope you're well — Acme is prepping for our annual vendor security review and we'd like to collect Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report and, if possible, give our external auditor (Claire Thompson at Pinnacle Audit, claire.thompson@pinnacle-audit.com) temporary access to the trust portal to download evidence. A few asks: 

- Can you confirm the audit period covered by the current Type II report? (we need precise start/end dates)
- Will you provide a bridge letter if the report doesn't cover our requested window (Jan 1 — Dec 31, 2025)?
- Can the portal link be time-bound (48–72 hours) for Claire to download artifacts?

We're targeting a procurement review on 23 Nov and would appreciate a response by EOD 19 Nov if possible.

Thanks,
Daniel

Acme Analytics

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear list. Short answers below; details and attachments follow.

- Audit period: our latest SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30.
- Bridge letter: we can provide a bridge letter that explains coverage beyond the report window; Marissa (security/compliance) will draft and send a customer-facing version.
- Portal access: we can provision a time-bound invite for Claire. The default trust portal invite expires after 24 hours; we can extend to 72 hours for auditor access.

I've attached the PDF copy of the Type II report for your review and requested Marissa to prepare the bridge letter. To provision the auditor link we need Claire's full name, email (you listed claire.thompson@pinnacle-audit.com, please confirm), and the desired window (48 vs 72 hours). Once confirmed we'll generate an invite and send the secure link and a short checklist for required evidence download (system logs, configuration docs, and any SOC attachments).

Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025.pdf (redacted for public disclosure)

Hi all — looping in final details and confirming next steps.

1) Confirmed audit coverage: SOC 2 Type II report covers 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30. Because Acme's requested window includes calendar-year 2025, we will provide a bridge letter that states: 
- Redwood Inference has maintained the same control environment and no exceptions were identified in the period following the report through 2025-12-31 (subject to auditor verification).

2) Portal access: Jonas will generate a time-bound invite via our trust portal. The invite will be set for 72 hours and will require the auditor to accept standard AUP terms (we will present the AUP when they click the invite).

3) Attachments and artifacts: per Claire's ask, attached is a short evidence checklist to guide the auditor. If there are additional requests beyond the checklist we can stage those in a secure transfer after initial download.

Attachments (included): 
- bridge-letter-acme-draft.docx (draft — please review and let us know if you need revised language)
- SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf (artifact list for downloads)

4) DocuSign: we've prepared a bridge-letter envelope if you want a signed bridge letter. Link: https://docusign.net/DocuSign/Envelope12345

Server-side note for clarity: the portal invite link will show an expiry time in the invitation email. We will not share screenshots of evidence — downloads only.

Next steps for Acme: confirm Claire's email (confirmed), approve the bridge letter draft (or provide edits), and let Jonas know if 72 hours works. We'll then create the invite and send the secure URL.
